official_documents.title: Business Asset User Profile Access
requirements: Requires App Review before live data access.
Allows reading User Fields for users engaging with business assets (examples: id, ids_for_business, name, picture).
Allowed usage: read one or more User Fields in a business app experience; analytics only if aggregated/de-identified/anonymized and not re-identifiable.
Only available with business verification; additional contracts may be required.

official_documents.title: User Profile API (Messenger Platform)
requirements: Advanced Access for Business Asset User Profile Access required to retrieve user profile information.
profile_pic field requires Business Asset User Profile Access feature.
Unable to access profile → empty object (when applicable).

official_documents.title: App Review Screen Recordings
requirements: Submission must include screen recordings demonstrating how to test every permission and feature requested.
Recordings are used as a guide when reviewers test the app.
Show complete login flow from logged-out to logged-in.
Show permission granting where applicable, then show functionality that requires the permission/feature.
Show data usage: app user accessing data that requires the permission/feature and what the app does with that data.
If reviewers cannot verify need for a permission/feature from recordings, it will not be approved.

official_documents.title: App Review (overview / tutorial materials)
requirements: Provide written reasons for requesting permissions/features during submission.
Certify allowed usage for advanced access permissions/features.

OFFICIAL_META_REQUIREMENT: Allowed usage: User Fields in business app experience
Advanced Access for live User Profile API including profile_pic
Screencast demonstrating each requested feature and data usage
Written use-case explanation in submission form
INFERENCE: Rejection often correlates with screencast not clearly showing ID/name/picture fields in the product UI (common App Review failure pattern; not independently proven for THIS rejection).
Developer Policy visibility of permission use in-app is a frequent BAUPA dispute topic in community forums — not used as primary evidence for HubChat's specific rejection.

With BAUPA rejected, Production Graph 100/33 prevents demonstrating live profile_pic for non-role users — resubmission likely needs App Role / Standard Access test path or equivalent reviewer test instructions.

non_primary_sources_excluded_as_authorit: Meta Community forum posts (referenced only as INFERENCE caution, not rejection reason for HubChat)
